title: Response Inventory Item
description: Schema for a single row in the read-only response inventory dataset.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for the experimental run.

collection_order.description: Planned sequential order of collection from the manifest.

provider.description: API provider or service name (e.g., OpenRouter, Groq).

tool.description: Tool or interface name if applicable; null for direct API.

model_condition_id.description: Model condition code (e.g., M1, M2, M3, M4).

workflow.description: Workflow or interface mode if applicable; null for direct API.

replicate.description: Run repetition code (e.g., R01, R02, R03).

manifest_path.description: Repository-relative path to the governing manifest.

rendered_prompt_path.description: Repository-relative path to the rendered prompt file.

expected_prompt_sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 hash of the rendered prompt.

response_artifact_path.description: Repository-relative path to the raw response artifact, or null if pending.

collection_status.description: Current status of data collection for this run.

completion_status.description: Model completion status (e.g., COMPLETED, TRUNCATED), or null if pending.

truncated.description: Whether the response was truncated by output token limits, or null if pending.

token_count.description: Total completion tokens produced, or null if pending.

interface_pass.description: Interface format/compliance pass indicator, or null if not applicable.
